the polymer-copper (II) complexes are promising anticancer agents.

the development of new polymer grafted metal complexes with enhanced DNA-binding and cytotoxic properties.
the synthesis of polymer-copper(ii) complexes with different degree of copper(II) coordination and their interaction with DNA.

the polymer-copper complexes can act as potential anti-cancer agents.
